per_bar_read.method: one scratchpad scan of the master (nothing written): RMS per 2.4 s bar and per 0.2 s, onset flux, band energies, chroma per 1.2 s. Bar = 240 / 100 = 2.4 s, bar n starts at file 2.4 n (phase 0.0). The phase comes from the section cuts, cross-correlated to the master: the intro cut is master 0.0 to 28.8 (bars 0-11, ncc 1.00) and the chorus cut starts on master 268.8 (the bar 112 line, ncc 1.00) and is the ending of the master itself; the verse cut starts at master 42.6, a quarter bar off the grid, and is not used. The drone has no audible pulse (the onset autocorrelation shows no peak on the beat or the bar), so the grid belongs to the arrangement, it is not a beat you hear. Chroma: the same three pitch classes lead every window from 0 to 300 s, ONE static chord and no chord cycle, so a jump cannot land on a wrong chord.
